Word List

Detailed Meanings

sections.title: Exercise 1: Choose the answer that best fits the question.

questions.content: If you invert a bottle, you
questions.explanation: invert (v): turn it upside down.

questions.content: Which of the following would most likely require the use of a funnel?
questions.explanation: funnel (n): object with a wide top and narrow bottom for pouring liquids.

questions.content: What is a wolf's prey?
questions.explanation: prey (n): animals hunted and eaten by another creature.

questions.content: Which is hereditary?
questions.explanation: hereditary (adj): a trait passed onto children from parents.

questions.content: If something is fragrant, you
questions.explanation: fragrant (adj): has a pleasant smell.

questions.content: Who uses seasoning at work?
questions.explanation: seasoning (n): a mix of salt, herbs, and spices to improve taste.

questions.content: Which of the following describes a kind of deputy?
questions.explanation: deputy (n): the second-highest-ranking person.

questions.content: What is made from sodium?
questions.explanation: sodium (n): an element used to make substances such as salt.

questions.content: Where would you most likely hear a hymn?
questions.explanation: hymn (n): a religious song praising a god.

questions.content: If your brother is sarcastic, he
questions.explanation: sarcastic (adj): the opposite of what is actually meant, often insulting.

sections.title: Exercise 3: Write a word that is similar in meaning to the underlined part.

questions.content:
He liked to pour the strong tasting liquid made from sour wine directly on his salad. [ 21 ]

To better explain the procedure, he used a great way to show that things are similar. [ 22 ]

We were in awe of the performance of the skilled person who uses a bow and arrows. [ 23 ]

The war was a means to overthrow the cruel and unfair government. [ 24 ]

I have a feeling that the robbery was a secret plan to do something illegal by the owners. [ 25 ]

At the library, we learned how to trace our line of people from which we descended. [ 26 ]

The people were convinced that the strange visitor was a person chosen by God. [ 27 ]

The father acted like a person who treated people in a cruel and unfair way. [ 28 ]

The British nobleman was a very kind and respected man. [ 29 ]

The new mayor's first priority was to select a second most important person. [ 30 ]
questions.explanation: vinegar: a strong tasting liquid made from sour wine.
analogy: a connection made to show that things are similar.
archer: a person who uses a bow and arrows.
tyranny: a cruel and unfair government.
conspiracy: a secret plan to do something illegal.
ancestry: the series of people from whom a person descended.
prophet: a person chosen by God.
tyrant: a person who treats people in a cruel, harsh, and unfair way.
earl: a nobleman from Britain.
deputy: the second-highest-ranking person.

sections.title: Exercise 4: Write C if the italicized word is used correctly. Write I if the word is used incorrectly.

questions.content: The sarcastic teacher was always sure to speak clearly and honestly with his students.
questions.explanation: Sarcastic means the opposite of what is meant, which conflicts with speaking clearly and honestly.

questions.content: The tyranny at the church made people feel welcome.
questions.explanation: Tyranny is cruel and unfair, which contradicts making people feel welcome.

questions.content: The mechanic used a funnel to pour the gas into the tank.
questions.explanation: A funnel is used to pour liquids.

questions.content: Because of the analogy, many people were injured.
questions.explanation: Analogy is a comparison, which doesn't directly cause injury.

questions.content: I think the addition of more sodium to the recipe made the bread too salty.
questions.explanation: Sodium forms salt, which makes things salty.

parts.title: Comprehensive Reading
parts.content:
The Earl of Shining

In the village of Hampton, there was an old soldier named Michael, but he was known to the world as the earl of Shining. Michael was once an expert archer and a great fighter. In fact, his skills seemed to be hereditary; all the people in his ancestry were famous warriors. However, he was getting old and no longer wished to fight.

One day, he was in the forest hunting prey when he saw a beautiful prophet singing a hymn. She said, "Michael, an evil army is involved in a conspiracy to take over Hampton. You're the only one who can defeat them and stop the tyranny. The village needs you!"

Michael replied, "But I'm too old to fight! I'm not confident that I can do it."

The prophet said, "You must try. I will even make a potion to increase your strength."

The prophet took out a bottle and a funnel. She poured some vinegar and garlic into the bottle. Next, she added some seasoning and sodium and shook it up.

Michael smelled the potion. "Wow, this is fragrant," he said in a sarcastic tone. He inverted the bottle and drank the whole potion. He immediately felt stronger. "I'll try my best," he promised.

Michael rode his horse to a hilltop, where he could see the village of Hampton below. He saw the evil tyrant and his men marching in a procession through the town.

Michael charged down the hill and into the village. An enemy deputy officer shouted, "He looks as strong as an ox!" It was an apt analogy. Michael grabbed the officer and threw him across the street with one arm. The rest of the officers screamed and rode away, and their army followed.

The prophet reappeared. Michael said, "It's a good thing you gave me the potion."

She replied, "But Michael, the potion was fake! Your strength really came from having confidence!"

Michael realized he really was still great. He just needed to believe in himself.

sections.title: Part A: Mark each statement T for true or F for false.

questions.content: The Earl of Hampton was an expert archer who was in the forest hunting prey.
questions.explanation: Câu này ĐÚNG. Đoạn 1 và 2 có nhắc đến việc Michael là một cung thủ xuất sắc và đang đi săn: "Michael was once an expert archer... One day, he was in the forest hunting prey" (Michael từng là một cung thủ xuất sắc... Một ngày nọ, ông đang đi săn mồi trong rừng).

questions.content: The prophet used a funnel to put vinegar, garlic, some seasoning, and sodium in a bottle.
questions.explanation: Câu này ĐÚNG. Trong đoạn 5, tác giả viết: "The prophet took out a bottle and a funnel. She poured some vinegar and garlic... added some seasoning and sodium..." (Nhà tiên tri lấy ra một cái chai và một cái phễu. Cô ấy đổ một ít giấm và tỏi... thêm một số gia vị và natri...).

questions.content: The evil tyrant and his men marched in a procession through the town.
questions.explanation: Câu này ĐÚNG. Đoạn 7 có miêu tả: "He saw the evil tyrant and his men marching in a procession through the town." (Ông nhìn thấy tên bạo chúa xấu xa và đồng bọn đang diễu hành qua thị trấn).

questions.content: The prophet, who sang a hymn, was involved in a conspiracy to take over Hampton.
questions.explanation: Câu này SAI. Theo đoạn 2, nhà tiên tri hát thánh ca ("singing a hymn") nhưng chính đội quân xấu xa mới là kẻ tham gia vào âm mưu chiếm đoạt Hampton ("an evil army is involved in a conspiracy to take over Hampton"), không phải nhà tiên tri.

questions.content: Michael’s strength really came from the fragrant potion.
questions.explanation: Câu này SAI. Ở đoạn 10, nhà tiên tri tiết lộ: "...the potion was fake! Your strength really came from having confidence!" (Lọ thuốc là giả đấy! Sức mạnh của ông thực sự đến từ sự tự tin!).

questions.content: What suggests that Michael’s skills were hereditary?
options: All the people in his ancestry were famous warriors.
He was known as the Earl of Shining.
He grabbed the officer and threw him.
questions.explanation: Trong đoạn 1 có ghi: "...his skills seemed to be hereditary; all the people in his ancestry were famous warriors." (...kỹ năng của ông dường như được di truyền; tất cả những người trong tổ tiên của ông đều là những chiến binh nổi tiếng). Vì vậy, đáp án đúng là A.

questions.content: What analogy did an enemy deputy officer use to describe Michael?
options: "He looks as strong as an ox!"
questions.explanation: Ở đoạn 8, viên sĩ quan của phe địch đã kêu lên: "He looks as strong as an ox!" (Ông ta trông khỏe như một con bò tót!). Đây chính là phép so sánh (analogy) được sử dụng. Đáp án A là chính xác.

questions.content: What did Michael say in a sarcastic tone before he inverted the bottle?
questions.explanation: Trong đoạn 6 có viết: "Wow, this is fragrant, he said in a sarcastic tone." ("Chà, thơm quá nhỉ", ông nói với một giọng điệu mỉa mai). Do đó đáp án là A.

questions.content: What did Michael say after the prophet said the village needed him to stop the tyranny?
options: "I'm too old to fight! I'm not confident that I can do it."
questions.explanation: Ở đoạn 3, sau khi nghe nhà tiên tri nói, Michael đã đáp lại: "But I'm too old to fight! I'm not confident that I can do it." (Nhưng ta đã quá già để chiến đấu rồi! Ta không tự tin là mình có thể làm được). Đáp án A là chính xác.

questions.content: What did Michael realize after his final encounter with the prophet?
options: Michael realized he really was still great. He just needed to believe in himself.
Michael realized the potion was fragrant.
Michael realized he was an earl.
Michael realized he was too old to fight.
questions.explanation: Câu cuối cùng của truyện (đoạn 11) cho biết: "Michael realized he really was still great. He just needed to believe in himself." (Michael nhận ra mình thực sự vẫn rất tuyệt vời. Ông chỉ cần tin vào chính mình). Đáp án A là chính xác.
